# @dxtmisha/figma

> Core communication middleware for Figma plugins, providing a structured bidirectional messaging bridge between sandbox logic and the UI layer.

Abstracts `window.postMessage` and `figma.ui.postMessage` into a type-safe, verified event bus with security tokens (`FigmaPostCode`) to prevent message collisions, ensure origin authenticity, and coordinate asynchronous data queries between the Figma plugin backend and UI iframes.

## Key Classes & Functions

### Messaging & Security
- [FigmaUiMessenger](src/classes/FigmaUiMessenger.ts): UI-side messaging singleton (`getInstance()`) for subscribing to backend events and posting requests.
- [FigmaPostAbstract](src/classes/FigmaPostAbstract.ts): Abstract base class for type-safe message verification, payload validation, and event handling.
- [FigmaPostCode](src/classes/FigmaPostCode.ts): Security token verification ensuring channel authenticity and message uniqueness.

### Frame & Selection Synchronization
- [fetchTopLevelFrames](src/functions/fetchTopLevelFrames.ts): Async helper to query top-level canvas frame hierarchies from the UI with empty-list safety.
- [fetchFramesSelected / sendFramesSelected](src/functions/fetchFramesSelected.ts): Query and toggle selected Figma canvas nodes from UI components with lifecycle auto-cleanup.
- [fetchFrameSelection / sendFrameSelection](src/functions/fetchFrameSelection.ts): Subscribe to canvas selection changes or programmatically select frames by ID.
- [fetchFrameStyles / sendFrameStyles](src/functions/fetchFrameStyles.ts): Query extracted CSS styles for specified frames and dispatch style update attributes.

### Storage Persistence
- [fetchClientStorage / sendClientStorage](src/functions/fetchClientStorage.ts): Async wrappers for retrieving and persisting user preferences via `figma.clientStorage` with fallback value support.
- [fetchStorage / sendStorage](src/functions/fetchStorage.ts): Async wrappers for reading and writing node or document `pluginData` with optional node ID targeting.
